content.text:
I merged this PR and published **[v0.36.1](https://github.com/cv/pit/releases/tag/v0.36.1)**.

**Conflicts:** none needed fixing. Your branch already had main merged into it. While I was working, main gained one commit (`7c86e05`, CI workflow only). That commit doesn't overlap this PR, so GitHub updated the branch without conflicts. CI passed again on the updated branch, and `npm run check` and `npm test` (1,827 tests) also passed locally.

**Merge:** I squash-merged this PR as `e4bf6ca`, so your branch's merge commit didn't land on main.

**Release:** I followed `docs/releasing.md`:
- **Release PR:** #364 (`release-0.36.1`) bumps `package.json` and `package-lock.json` to 0.36.1. It moves the Unreleased CHANGELOG entry under `## [0.36.1] - 2026-11-13` and points the README's pinned install at `v0.36.1`. Before opening it, I ran `npm audit --omit=dev`, `npm run check`, `npm run package:check` and `npm pack --dry-run`; all passed. CI passed on the PR, and I rebase-merged it as `0bc62ed`.
- **Tag:** I pushed the annotated tag `v0.36.1` on `0bc62ed`. The Release workflow succeeded and published the release; it's not a draft and has no assets.
- **Post-release check:** a fresh clone of the tag installed its runtime dependencies, and the sandbox check returned `2`. CI on the release commit on main also passed.

**Not done:** two interactive checks in Pi still need a person:
- that labels show up in collapsed and expanded rows (still unchecked in this PR's checklist);
- the reload smoke test in the release guide.
